• TreeView Control: Hierarchy: Displays nested hierarchical data using parent and child TreeNodes. Node Management: Add items using tvw.Nodes.Add("Title"). Selection: SelectedNode identifies the currently clicked item in memory.
• ListView Control: Tabular Layout: Renders flat row items across multiple subitem columns. View Modes: Toggles between Details, LargeIcon, SmallIcon, and Tile views. SubItems: Holds and updates additional column cells per row entry.
